wz.tombol.ubah.label: Edit {apa}
wz.bahasa.bubble: Hi! Before we start, which language do you want? The wizard, your dashboard and your team will all use it.
wz.bahasa.bantu: You can change it any time from the More menu in your dashboard. Team roles & SOPs stay in Indonesian for now.
wz.halo.bubble: Hi! I'm Builder, I'll be running your office. I'll ask you 3 things, then I'll set everything up. About 5 minutes.
wz.halo.2: I won't ask about your products or prices now. I'll ask later while we chat.
wz.halo.3: This setup doesn't use your Claude quota.
wz.kenalan.bubble: Just two things. Your team will use this name when they report to you or ask for a decision.
wz.tim.judul: Which teams do you want to start with?
wz.tim.bubble: Just tick them. Names and jobs are ready. I'd start with two; adding more later is easy.
wz.tim.salah: Pick at least one team first.
wz.tim.builder: Always there. Runs the office: adds teams, changes the look, sets working hours.
wz.tim.bantu: Need another team or a different manager name? Tell me after setup.
wz.tim.detak.judul: When should the team work on its own?
wz.tim.detak.bantu: The team wakes up on schedule, checks its work, and keeps going. No work = no wake-up, no quota used. It starts once your business details are complete (I'll ask when we chat).
wz.tim.detak.ganti: You can change the schedule any time through me.
wz.tampilan.bubble: This is what you see when you open the dashboard on your phone. The characters move around based on what your team is doing.
wz.tampilan.karakter.bantu: You show up in the owner's room every time you open the dashboard, and the team reports to you there.
wz.tampilan.bantu: You can change the template & character any time from the More menu in your dashboard.
wz.cek.bubble: After you tap Set up office, wait 3–5 minutes and keep this page open.
wz.cek.bawaan.gaya: Your team writes in friendly, plain English.
wz.cek.bawaan.mati: The team works when you chat with them. You can turn on automatic work later.
wz.cek.bawaan.otomatis: Automatic work starts once your business details are complete, so the team doesn't write based on guesses.
wz.cek.bawaan.task: Each team gets its first task right away, from a sample SOP.
wz.cek.bawaan.larangan: Standard rules: no "number 1" claims, no bashing competitors, no promises beyond your data.
wz.cek.bawaan.ubah: You can change all of this through me.
wz.proses.gagal.bubble: An important step failed, so I stopped to avoid a half-built office.
wz.proses.gagal.ulang: Log back in to your VPS (as root) and paste the setup command from your purchase code email again. Finished steps will be skipped.
wz.proses.gagal.simpan: Your answers are saved, so you won't have to start over.
wz.proses.bubble: I'm on it. Please keep this page open, about 3–5 minutes.
wz.akhir.pw.bubble: This is the key to open your office from your phone. It's shown only once, so save it now in your notes or a password manager.
wz.akhir.kantor.bubble: Open it and sign in with that password. Each team sits at its desk, and you can see who's working on what.
wz.akhir.kantor.qr: On a laptop? Scan to open it on your phone.
wz.akhir.kantor.bantu: Save this address. Easiest: open it on your phone, then "Add to Home Screen".
wz.akhir.obrol.bubble: Now let's properly meet. I'll ask about your business (products, prices, tone) with options you just tap.
wz.akhir.obrol.1: Open the Claude app on your phone (the one with your subscription).
wz.akhir.obrol.tim: Once your business details are done, call your team: {nama}.
wz.akhir.notif.bubble: Last one, and it can wait. Once automatic work is on, your team will ping you when they need a decision.
wz.akhir.notif.gagal: {n} steps didn't work yet: {daftar}. Your office still works. Tell me: "jadi builder, cek kesehatan kantor".
wz.akhir.notif.iphone: On iPhone, or if the button doesn't work: open ntfy, tap +, paste this name, then Subscribe. Treat this name like a password and don't share it.
wz.akhir.notif.qr: On a laptop? Scan with your phone camera (Android).
wz.akhir.notif.terkirim: Test notification sent. Didn't get it? Make sure you copy-pasted the topic name, then allow notifications for ntfy in your phone settings.
wz.akhir.notif.belum: The notification topic isn't ready. Later, tell me: "jadi builder, sambungin notif".
wz.akhir.notif.nanti: Notifications later? No problem, tap Done. Tell me any time: "jadi builder, sambungin notif".
wz.akhir.notif.isi: Hi! Notifications from your office are working.
wz.tolak.isi: Open the full link printed in your VPS terminal (the one with the random code at the end). If you closed the terminal, run {perintah} again to get a new link.
wz.tolak.asal.isi: This page can only be submitted from {alamat}.
wz.tutup.bubble: All done. See you in the Claude app!
wz.tutup.isi: This link no longer works. Carry on in the Claude app and type jadi builder.
wz.masuk.isi: If your link was cut off, paste the short code or full link from the terminal here. I will open the wizard once the code matches.
wz.masuk.label: Paste the code or link from the terminal
wz.masuk.salah: The code or link does not match. Copy it from the terminal again.
wz.masuk.tunggu: Too many attempts. Try again later, in at most one hour.
